task: Preserve existing output files during directory validation
diagnosis: The fixed .write_test_temp probe truncates and deletes an existing file, and rejects a writable directory when that child name is already a directory.
change: Use an exclusively created temporary probe with context-managed cleanup; report creation and write failures without modifying pre-existing paths.
local_validation: 12 cases run: 11 pass and one symlink case is skipped because the local Windows account cannot create symlinks. Includes concurrent validation and simulated permission/disk-write errors. Hosted Linux and Windows checks must pass before release.
generation_or_data_changes: No QR generation, phone enumeration, payment, provider call or real checkpoint access. Generator, launcher and checkpoint behavior are unchanged.
remaining_findings: Checkpoint atomicity and range/output binding, range memory usage, launcher checkpoint deletion/input handling, and import-time signal ownership remain separate follow-ups.
next: Pass required hosted checks, release the source, and verify the main-branch run. This CLI repo has no Vercel project link or deployment workflow; the portfolio Vercel hold still applies elsewhere.
